## In brief

**Now** — Research Fellow, Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, National University
of Singapore (Human Potential Translational Research Programme & Heat Resilience
and Performance Centre), since April 2025. Analytical lead across Project HEATS
and Cooling Singapore 2.0.

**Before** — Postdoctoral Research Associate, Department of Nutritional Sciences,
King's College London (2024–25). Assistant Lecturer in Exercise Physiology and
in Sport & Exercise Nutrition, Atlantic Technological University, Sligo
(2021–22). Health Advisor, Bupa UK (2018–19).

**JSPS HOPE Fellow** — Japan Society for the Promotion of Science, March 2026.

**Winner, Postgraduate Competition** — The Nutrition Society (UK & Ireland),

## Funding

**Climate Impact Science Research Programme**, NRF Singapore & National
Environment Agency (CISR-2024-2R-04) — Exertional Heat Vulnerability Index for
Singapore. Research team member leading the evidence-synthesis workstream;
protocol lead and review guarantor.

**NRF CREATE** — Project HEATS. Named contributor delivering the statistical
analysis plan and leading manuscript development for the heat exposure
workstream.
